orchestkit · regen drift

Three generated files went stale at v9.3.0

Running npm run build on a clean checkout of main produces a diff. That means these files have been out of date since the 9.3.0 release, and no CI check noticed. This PR is exactly that build output, nothing hand-edited.

What drifted

FileStale becauseGenerator
README.md what's-new block missing the v9.3.0 entry, still topped by v9.2.1 stamp-whats-new.mjs
docs/site/lib/generated/changelog-data.ts no v9.3.0 release record, so the docs site changelog stops at 9.2.1 docs-site codegen
package-lock.json version still 8.84.10 while package.json says 9.3.0 npm install

The lockfile one is the oldest

package.json        9.3.0
package-lock.json   8.84.10   roughly 40 releases behind

release-please bumps package.json but does not run npm install, so the lockfile's own version field only catches up when a human happens to install. It is cosmetic, since dependency resolution does not read it, but it makes the lockfile a misleading thing to grep.

Why nothing caught it

Would it have caught this?
A build-drift check on every PRexisted, but too narrow
The release-please File Guardguards edits, not staleness
Someone running a full build locallythis is how it surfaced

The gate was not missing. ci.yml has run a build-drift check since #2360, but it diffed only plugins/ and src/hooks/dist/, while npm run build also writes README and the docs-site generated data. Those outputs could sit stale indefinitely.

The fix: widen the gate that already existed

.github/workflows/ci.yml, Check for uncommitted build changes

  - git diff --quiet plugins/ src/hooks/dist/
  + GENERATED=(plugins/ src/hooks/dist/ README.md docs/site/lib/generated/)
  + git diff --quiet -- "${GENERATED[@]}"

Deliberately NOT added: package-lock.json. Its version field drifts because release-please bumps package.json without running npm install, and npm run build does not regenerate it, so gating it here would fail for a reason this job cannot fix. That one is a release-process gap, tracked separately.

Verified locally: appending a newline to README.md makes the widened check fire, and actionlint is clean on the changed step.

Dashboard archetype per playground-visual-standard.md section 0. Produced by npm run build on a clean worktree of origin/main; no file here was hand-edited.
